2608.13333.title: LLM-Guided Graph Generation for Structure-Based Local Improvement Methods
2608.13333.paper_summary: Large neighborhood search normally selects a random subset of decision variables for iterative optimization. For efficiently solving different problems, researchers tend to design variable selection strategies by taking into account structural features from different domains. In this paper, we build an automatic pipeline that is problem-agnostic to all problems in the MiniZinc format. By prompting an LLM with our semantic guidelines, we guide the LLM to produce a graph generator that maps any instance of a problem type to a uniform weighted graph, where nodes represent decision variables and edges represent constraint relationships. These problem-agnostic graphs guide our structure-based local improvement framework (SLIM) in variable selection. Meanwhile, the weighted graph enables all problem instances to share the same generic graph representation, from which the same graph features can be extracted and used for configuration selection. We evaluated our pipeline on instances across 20 MiniZinc competition problems, finding that algorithm selection achieves a 39.5% average problem-weighted win rate against a one-shot Gurobi baseline, more than doubling the best single configuration (19.3%). Configuration and feature ablation boost the performance further to 44.0%, demonstrating that LLM-based semantic generation enables effective automated structure extraction and feature extraction for constraint optimization.
2608.13333.paper_summary_zh: 大型鄰域搜尋通常會隨機選擇一部分決策變數進行迭代優化。為了有效解決不同的問題，研究人員傾向於設計變數選擇策略，考慮來自不同領域的結構特徵。在本文中，我們建立了一個對所有MiniZinc格式問題無關的自動化流程。通過用我們的語義指導提示一個LLM，我們引導LLM生成一個圖形生成器，將任何問題類型的實例映射到一個均勻加權圖，其中節點代表決策變數，邊代表約束關係。這些與問題無關的圖形引導我們的基於結構的局部改進框架（SLIM）進行變數選擇。與此同時，加權圖使所有問題實例共享相同的通用圖形表示，從中可以提取相同的圖形特徵並用於配置選擇。我們在20個MiniZinc競賽問題的實例上評估了我們的流程，發現算法選擇相對於一次性Gurobi基線達到了39.5%的平均問題加權勝率，這是最佳單一配置（19.3%）的兩倍多。配置和特徵消融進一步提升了性能至44.0%，顯示出基於LLM的語義生成能有效實現自動化結構提取和特徵提取，以進行約束優化。
